sections.text_helper: Section 28.8.17 "SAES suspend registers (SAES_SUSPRx)" in chapter 28 (Secure AES coprocessor (SAES)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 887.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x040 + 0x4 * x, (x = 0 to 7)
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:0 SUSP[31:0]: Suspend data
SAES_SUSPRx registers contain the complete internal register states of the SAES when the CCM
processing of the current task is suspended to process a higher-priority task. Refer to
Section28.4.8: SAES suspend and resume operations for more details.
Clearing EN bit of the SAES_CR register clears this register to zero.
SAES_SUSPRx registers are not used in other chaining modes than CCM.
